profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Results-oriented Software Engineer with 8 years of experience in analysis, design, development, testing, and implementation of various embedded applications. Experienced in a variety of platforms, languages and embedded systems. Skilled at team collaboration and working effectively in dynamic environments. Proficient in C, C++, and Python programming languages along with embedded programming, agile methodologies, and script automation.

Using strong motives to apply my abilities and creativity to drive my technical skills to enhance the quality and security of business and corporations alike. 

Skills:
• C, C++, Python; 
• Eclipse Platforms; VxWorks
• GitLab (CI/CD)
• Windows and Linux OS
• UML	
• SCRUM/AGILE Dev. Methodology
• Micro-Controller
• MATLAB
• Unit Testing
• Script automation
• Bilingual- English and Spanish
